section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1998
title: 2.5.2 Suicides due to ‘Illicit relation’, ‘Bankruptcy’, ‘Illness’ and ‘Family problem’ have shown an increasing trend in the last 3 years. However, the significant increase of 209 percent was noticed for suicides cases due to ‘AIDS/STD’, 52.5 percent due to ‘Hero worshipping’ and 49.5 percent due to ‘Professional/Career problems’ in 1998 as compared to 1997. 2.5.3 Suicides due to ‘Illegitimate Pregnancy’ and ‘Property Dispute’ have decreased over past three years. However, when compared over previous year (1997), the suicides due to ‘Failure in Examination’ and ‘Unemployment’ also showed decreases of nearly 10 percent. 2.5.4 State, UT and City-wise details on the various causes for suicides are presented in Table-22. The States/Uts which reported more than the All-India average share under the two major causes of suicides i.e. Illness and Family Problems are grouped in the following table.
